statement: The app of a token is its issuer's decision. A tenant switch issues the new token for the app its TenantSwitch answers (TenantMembership.app), which must be one a token can carry as its aud, and otherwise for the previous token's app. An app the switch's credentials name (targetAppId) reaches the new token only through that answer, never as named.
guards: login:SwitchTenantAuthenticationTest#a switch that answers an app issues the token for it
login:SwitchTenantAuthenticationTest#an app the credentials name and the answer does not return is never issued
login:SwitchTenantAuthenticationTest#an answered app that cannot be an app id refuses the switch
